title: Hinomori Shizuku — A Night Date At PXL〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This seems like a good place to stop, so why don't we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great work today, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I agree. Very nice work.
Anyway, I need to head off right away today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Got somewhere to go?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, my mother asked me to do something for her... It has to do with this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, it's a ticket for a drawing at the mall!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I remember seeing that recently. You can win a TV and a trip to some hot springs, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A drawing...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But this ticket says this is the last day to use it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know, but my mother's busy with work and asked me to go in her place.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can you make it there on your own?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll be fine, Airi.
I've gone to the mall plenty of times before.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, but that doesn't mean you know where you're supposed to turn this ticket in, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's true...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was planning to stay and practice a little more, but maybe I should go with you instead...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, I couldn't ask you to do that.
It's just a drawing so...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't I go with you♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: L-Luka? You will...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes♪ If I go, Airi can stay and practice, no? Not only that, we'd be reducing the likelihood of you getting lost.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's right. I'd feel much better if she went with you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thank you for volunteering like this, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I hope you win something, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
Wish me luck!
Drawing Area

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm glad we found this place without much issue♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I really appreciate it, Luka. I had no trouble finding my way through the mall.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<You're very welcome♪
Truth be told, I was curious about what this “drawing” would be like.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Let's see...>

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: White means a consolation prize.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They spin the little dispenser each time and the color of the ball that comes out determines what you get.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but it looks like the first prize, the hot springs package, and the second prize, the big TV, have already been claimed.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, I noticed that too.
Apparently, a gold one meant first prize. It would've been nice to see what that actually looked like.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But third prize is still there... Oh, it's a pair of tickets to an amusement park♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... It says you can choose from a list of amusement parks too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it even includes Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But winning such a wonderful prize won't be easy. The consolation prize is a box of tissues, which also would be nice since it's starting to get chilly.

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Next person, please!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, it's our turn.
I'll be waiting in your pocket, so good luck, Shizuku♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Okay, two tickets.
Let's start with your first one!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Tissues are... A white ball...
Please, white...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, it's a white one. Congratulations, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: We're down to the last few drawings, so your odds of winning something nice should be a little higher. It's okay to think big here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see... It certainly didn't sound like there were many balls left in the dispenser.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Fourth prize is a microwave, so that may be nice. My mother has been talking about buying a new one.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That means you're looking for a yellow one! I believe in you, Shizuku♪>

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: If you spin it in reverse, it'll help mix everything inside better so feel free to spin it as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll try doing that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Luka, would you mind telling me when to stop?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, are you sure? In that case...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <S-Stop...!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Luka!
Okay, here we go...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's not yellow...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, it's blue.>

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Third prize! Congratulations!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I never would've imagined that I'd win those amusement park tickets. It must be because you told me when to stop spinning, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If that's the case, you're very welcome♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, also.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I just let my mother know that we had won these tickets, and she said I could use them however I like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's wonderful♪
Where would you like to go?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm leaning towards Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori and Haruka mentioned that they'd be going as well, so I think I'll invite Airi to come with me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you and the others like to come along as well?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <U-Us?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! After all, you're very likely the reason why we won these tickets today, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh... Thank you, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <MEIKO and Len seemed interested in seeing the night show, so I'm sure they'll want to go as well♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'll be sure to ask them when I get back to SEKAI♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And thank you so much for joining me today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. You're very welcome♪>
